mapper.sql: emp17_benefit_id AS benefit_id , emp17_company_id AS company_id , emp17_issue_date AS issue_date , emp17_benefit_cd AS benefit_code , f_cdnm('EmpBenefitType', emp17_benefit_cd, emp17_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS benefit_name , emp17_person_id AS person_id , f_emp_kor_nm(emp17_person_id) AS person_name , emp17_appr_id AS appr_id , apr01_title AS appr_title_name , emp17_issue_amt AS issue_amt , emp17_occ_date AS occ_date , emp17_benefit_detail AS benefit_detail , emp17_note AS note , emp17_benefit_yn AS benefit_yn , apr01_status_cd AS appr_status_code , f_cdnm('AprStatusCode', apr01_status_cd, apr01_company_id, apr01_reg_date) AS appr_status_name , emp17_pay_request_yyyymm AS pay_request_yyyymm
mapper.select: SELECT , NULL AS account_name FROM emp17_benefit INNER JOIN apr01_appr ON emp17_appr_id = apr01_appr_id WHERE emp17_company_id = #{companyId} AND emp17_issue_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{closeDate} AND emp17_benefit_cd LIKE #{benefitCode} AND emp17_pay_request_yyyymm IS NULL AND COALESCE(emp17_benefit_yn, 'false') != 'true' AND apr01_status_cd IN ('10', '20', '30') AND UPPER(CONCAT(f_cdnm('LinkCode', emp17_link_cd, emp17_company_id, f_sysdate()), f_emp_kor_nm(emp17_person_id), apr01_title)) LIKE UPPER(#{searchText}) ORDER BY emp17_issue_date DESC, emp17_person_id

SELECT , act01_account_nm AS account_name FROM emp17_benefit LEFT OUTER JOIN apr01_appr ON emp17_appr_id = apr01_appr_id INNER JOIN emp55_benefit_info ON ( emp55_company_id = emp17_company_id AND emp55_benefit_cd = emp17_benefit_cd ) LEFT OUTER JOIN act01_account_code ON ( act01_company_id = emp17_company_id AND act01_account_cd = emp55_account_cd ) WHERE emp17_company_id = #{companyId} AND emp17_pay_request_yyyymm = #{yyyymm} AND emp17_benefit_cd LIKE #{benefitCode} AND COALESCE(emp17_benefit_yn) LIKE #{benefitYnStr} AND emp17_pay_request_yyyymm IS NOT NULL AND UPPER(CONCAT(f_cdnm('LinkCode', emp17_link_cd, emp17_company_id, f_sysdate()), f_emp_kor_nm(emp17_person_id), apr01_title)) LIKE UPPER(#{searchText}) ORDER BY emp17_issue_date DESC, emp17_person_id

SELECT , NULL AS account_name FROM emp17_benefit LEFT OUTER JOIN apr01_appr ON emp17_appr_id = apr01_appr_id WHERE emp17_company_id = #{companyId} AND emp17_benefit_id IN #{id} ORDER BY emp17_benefit_id

SELECT sys09_code AS code , sys09_name AS name FROM sys08_code_kind INNER JOIN sys09_code a1 ON sys09_code_kind_id = sys08_code_kind_id LEFT OUTER JOIN emp55_benefit_info ON ( emp55_company_id = #{companyId} AND emp55_benefit_cd = sys09_code ) WHERE sys08_kind_cd = 'EmpBenefitType' AND sys09_company_id = 0 AND COALESCE(sys09_close_yn,'false') = 'false' AND sys09_apply_date = ( SELECT MAX(a2.sys09_apply_date) FROM sys09_code a2 WHERE a2.sys09_code_kind_id = a1.sys09_code_kind_id AND a2.sys09_code = a1.sys09_code AND a2.sys09_company_id = a1.sys09_company_id AND a2.sys09_apply_date <= f_today() ) AND COALESCE(emp55_un_use_yn, 'false') != 'true' GROUP BY sys09_code, sys09_name, sys09_seq
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO apr99_appr_del SELECT f_create_seq() , apr01_appr_id , apr01_title , apr01_reg_date , apr01_status_cd , apr01_content , apr01_note , apr01_reg_emp_id , apr01_effect_date , apr01_class_tree_id , apr01_stamp_id , apr01_receive_nm , apr01_reference_nm , apr01_stamp_seq , apr01_inout_cd , f_sysdate() , #{empId} , apr01_company_id , apr01_form_type , apr01_dcr_id_word , apr01_sign_company , apr01_sign_ceo , apr01_stamp_position , apr01_link_cd FROM apr01_appr WHERE apr01_appr_id = #{apprId}
